title: Statement of Work Classification and Pricing Terms — Professional Services Projects
content:
**Professional Services Projects — terms of classification and pricing of a statement of work.**

**1. Class.** Every statement of work is classed by its original contract value between the lowest and the highest original contract value of the class. An assessment-only scope (a discovery, security, network or cloud-readiness assessment with a findings report) is an Assessment Engagement, which is always fixed fee and includes the findings report as a deliverable.

**2. Class fixed at signature.** The class is fixed at signature and never changes through change orders.

**3. Pricing model.** A statement of work is priced fixed fee or time and materials as the pricing models the class allows permit. A time-and-materials statement of work carries a not-to-exceed amount as its contract value.

**4. Rate discount.** The former clause under which the rate discount of a statement of work was the class's ClearPath rate discount when, on the issue date, the client held a ClearPath agreement in active status whose tier rank was at least the lowest rank earning that discount, and 0 otherwise, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the rate discount of a statement of work.

**5. Validity.** A statement of work not signed within the class's validity period, counted in calendar days from its issue date, lapses. Work can then only be quoted on a new statement of work at current rates.

**6. Entitlements.** A dedicated project manager, the status report cadence and the steering committee cadence are entitlements of the class.

## Points of judgement

| Question | Answer under these terms |
|---|---|
| May a change order that raises the contract value move the engagement into a higher class? | No. The class is fixed at signature and never changes through change orders. |
| May an assessment-only scope be signed on time and materials? | No. An Assessment Engagement is always fixed fee. |
| What is the contract value of a time-and-materials statement of work? | Its not-to-exceed amount. |
| What happens to an unsigned statement of work after its validity period? | It lapses; the work can only be quoted on a new statement of work at current rates. |

Hypothetical illustration: an implementation statement of work issued at 40000.00 is a Standard Project; if signed change orders later take its contract value to 52000.00, it remains a Standard Project.

superseded_clauses: Its rate_discount_pct is clearpath_rate_discount_pct when, on the issue date, the client holds a ClearPath agreement whose status is active and whose tier rank is at least clearpath_discount_min_rank, and 0 otherwise.
